messages:
nora: Planning a short maintenance window 2026-04-09 23:00-00:30 UTC for apac-edge pool-gamma. Aim: NIC microcode + small PDU firmware update + nvlink sanity checks. Rolling reboots, minimal parallelism.
ash: Can we avoid draining nodes hosting long-running finetune jobs? I see 4 tenants with long jobs in that pool.
nora: Marked those as eviction_exempt; we'll prefer idle nodes first. Target cohorts: racks [g-01,g-02,g-03], ~96 GPUs.
devops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MW-7899  apac-edge pool-gamma maintenance. Ops channel alerted.
kevin: Note on networking: last time a PDU firmware set caused transient BMC flaps. Recommend apply to BMCs first, then PDU, and stagger by rack.
ops-oncall: I'll own monitoring 22:45-00:45 UTC. Will watch host-heartbeat, egress-qdepth, and p99 request latency. Pager standby.
ash: Capacity/backfill Q: If we push load to us-east spare pools, what's the expected cross-region egress cost hit?
kevin: Expect temporary +8-12% network egress on that route. Finance ok with <3h bursts per quarter. Logging ticket for chargeback.
nora: Proposed sequence: 1) cordon node 2) `drain --grace-period=180 --ignore-daemonsets` 3) apply BMC patch 4) apply PDU update via remote console 5) reboot 6) run nvlink-check 7) uncordon.
ops-oncall: Please set drain concurrency to 6 nodes and inter-cohort delay 3 minutes. Last run with concurrency 12 caused egress queue spikes.
ash: Add warm-cache seed: after uncordon run `python3 tools/kv_seed.py --pool gamma --duration 300`.
kevin: Add pre-unlock probe: `curl -s http://telemetry/api/pools/gamma/kv_hit | jq .rate` require >=0.7 for 5min rolling window. If failed, trigger warm-cache extension.
devops-bot: Reminder: runbook link https://wiki.redwood/mw/MW-7899 attached to ticket.
ops-oncall: Post-maint checklist: perf smoke (100 calls, p99 < 350ms), nvlink bandwidth test, verify no BMC flaps for 30m. If any BMC flaps, rollback PDU firmware.
nora: Whoever is drafting customer comms: short APAC banner + status page note. If we hit p95 >300ms we'll update status page.
ash: I'll draft comms and ping support for a localized APAC banner.
kevin: If thermal throttle observed during boot, route batch jobs to dedicated pool-theta and mark nodes for extended soak.
ops-oncall: I'll provision temporary alerts for egress-qdepth > 50k and p99 >400ms during the window. Pager on.
nora: Thanks team  will post final k8s job yaml and stagger plan 1h before start. :white_check_mark:
